title: 第93章 丧尸帝国（7）

第93章 丧尸帝国（7）-《反派BOSS有毒》

上一章

存书签

下一章

千黎。

本文中最大的反派，唯一的丧尸皇，外貌和人类没有任何差别，如果不是他说自己丧尸，绝对不会有人觉得他是丧尸。

带领丧尸几次攻进基地，除了女主所在的基地，其余的基地基本都覆灭了。

到最后所有的人类联合起来，由女主的带领，最终成功将其活捉。

为了研究丧尸皇和其他的丧尸不同，将他关在实验室研究，如何研究的不知道，但是过程肯定不怎么好就是了，最后他自爆了，整个实验室都被炸没了。

时笙瞄了几眼，眼巴巴瞅着自己的丧尸。

这丫的是未来的丧尸皇？

本宝宝竟然喂了一只丧尸皇！

还要带领他建立新世界秩序，维护世界和平……这个烂梗！本宝宝是拒绝的！

时笙眸子转了转，心底已经有了决断。

“换上，不许攻击白虎，不然我揍你！”时笙将干净的衣裳扔到千黎身上。

“嗬嗬！”千黎看了看白虎，又看了看时笙，“嗬嗬！”

时笙换好衣服出来，千黎正在脱上衣，少年的身体还很稚嫩，没什么看头，不过他背上纵横交错的伤痕却是看得时笙一阵心惊。

那些伤痕看上去年代很久了，狰狞的霸占了他整个后背。

在他肩胛的位置，有一个纹身，很奇怪，正要细看，千黎套上了上衣，伸手就把裤子扒了下去。

还没移开视线的时笙看了个正着。

时笙：“……”辣眼睛啊！

淡定的移开的视线，等千黎穿好，时笙才走过去，“今晚你守夜，有人来了叫我，不许攻击人。”

她不确定这货若是尝到了人血，还会不会保持冷静。

千黎迷茫的看着时笙，好一会儿点点头。

时笙睡到半夜的时候就惊醒了，在危险的世界，她自然不会睡得太死。

千黎就站在她旁边，直勾勾的盯着她，时笙掀开被子坐起来，没好气的道：“你站这里做什么，想吓死我啊！”

“嗬嗬……抱……”千黎张开双手。

时笙：“……”

她默默的站起来，伸手抱了一下千黎，冰冷又坚硬的长指甲从她脖子上刮过，时笙差点拎着剑砍了过去。

Qian Li.

The biggest villain in this article, the only Zombie King, looks no different from humans. If he hadn't said he was a zombie, no one would have thought he was a zombie.

He led the zombies to attack the base several times, and except for the base where the heroine was located, the rest of the bases were basically destroyed.

In the end, all humans united, led by the heroine, and finally succeeded in capturing him alive.

In order to study the difference between the Zombie King and other zombies, he was locked up in a laboratory for research. I don't know how to study it, but the process was definitely not very good. In the end, he blew himself up and the entire laboratory was blown up.

Shi Sheng glanced at his zombies for a few times.

Is this the future zombie king?

This baby actually fed a zombie king!

He also needs to lead him to establish a new world order and maintain world peace... This sucks!This baby refuses!

Shi Sheng rolled his eyes and already had a decision in his heart.

"Put on, don't attack Bai Hu, or I'll beat you up!" Shi Sheng threw the clean clothes on Qian Li.

"Ho ho!" Qian Li looked at Bai Hu and then at Shi Sheng, "Ho ho!"

Shi Sheng changed his clothes and came out. Qian Li was taking off his shirt. The boy's body was still very immature and not much to look at, but the crisscross scars on his back made Shi Sheng frightened.

Those scars looked very old, occupying his entire back ferociously.

There was a strange tattoo on his shoulder blade. Just as he was about to take a closer look, Qianli put on his shirt and reached out to take off his pants.

Shi Sheng, who hadn't looked away yet, looked at it.

Shi Sheng: "..." It's so annoying!

He calmly looked away and waited for Qian Li to put on his clothes before Shi Sheng walked over and said, "You stay vigil tonight. If someone comes and calls me, don't attack anyone."

She wasn't sure if this guy would remain calm if he tasted human blood.

Qian Li looked at Shi Sheng confusedly, then nodded for a while.

Shi Sheng woke up in the middle of the night. In a dangerous world, she would not sleep too hard.

Qian Li was standing next to her, staring straight at her. Shi Sheng lifted the quilt and sat up, saying angrily: "What are you doing standing here? You want to scare me to death!"

"Hoho...hug..." Qianli opened her hands.

Shi Sheng: "..."

She stood up silently and reached out to hug Qian Li. His cold and hard long nails scratched her neck, and Shi Sheng almost struck her with a sword.
